scope: All player classes; summoned creatures retain their own explicit frequencies
ratingCurve: The existing shared rating curve in services/attackSpeed.js, applied after all rating bonuses and penalties.
note: Same effective-rating curve for everyone; base frequency remains class-specific. This is an upper bound, not a promise that every class reaches two actions per second. No change to skill damage, Mana, cast times, cooldowns, Agility conversion or summoned creature speeds.
